validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed via a coherent, independently-fetched PNGRB regulatory paper trail spanning 2021-2026, not a GEM-only entity. (1) PNGRB Public Notice PNGRB/Auth/2-NGPL(09)/2021, 13.12.2021: an Expression of Interest from Prabha Energy Private Limited (PEPL) 'to lay, build, operate or expand Natural Gas pipeline from GGS-2, North Karanpura block, Hazaribagh to SV-3 of Urja-Ganga Natural Gas pipeline at Ranchi' -- names both endpoints and the purpose (tying a CBM gathering station into GAIL's Urja Ganga trunk). (2) PNGRB's competitive-bid document BID/NGPL/17/2022/01/HRPL, March 2022, 'Hazaribagh-Ranchi Natural Gas Pipeline (HRPL)', spanning 'about 68 km' with 'initial system capacity of at least 1.00 MMSCMD'. (3) PNGRB's live NGPL MIS register (checked at two editions, 30-Jun-2025 and 31-May-2026) both carry a Hazaribagh-Ranchi / IOCL / 09.02.2023 row with non-zero, INCREASING physical progress between editions (0 km welded -> 11 km welded, 0 km lowered -> 6 km lowered, of 65-71 km authorised) -- i.e. genuine ongoing pipe-laying, not a dormant paper authorization (contrast the country note's live-authorization trap: a static, unchanging 0-km entry would NOT be evidence of activity, but a growing welded/lowered figure is). All four documents are independently fetched pngrb.gov.in publications naming the same two endpoints; none is GEM-derived. CLASSIFICATION: correctly recorded as gas transmission -- this is a short common-carrier lateral (CBM gathering station to an existing trunk sectionalizing valve) rather than a long-haul trunk, but PNGRB regulates and authorises it under the identical common-carrier Natural Gas Pipeline framework as the larger lines in this roster (e.g. Kanai Chhata-Panitar, Gurdaspur-Jammu), and GEM's PipelineType='transmission' is used consistently across all PNGRB-authorised common-carrier lines in this dataset regardless of scale, so this is not a misclassification. DUPLICATE: checked against all 8 other roster rows (Chhara-Lonhtpur, Swan LNG-Dahej LNG, Bhatinda-Gurdaspur, Mehsana-Bhatinda, Gurdaspur-Jammu, Kakinada-Srikakulam, Kanai Chhata-Panitar, Ennore Barshi) -- none shares an endpoint, corridor, or authorisation with Hazaribagh-Ranchi; no relabel/double-count risk. ATTRIBUTION: Owner1=Indian Oil Corp (100%) matches PNGRB's register Entity field ('IOCL') at both editions checked; independently corroborated in kind (not in the specific 100%-pipeline-ownership fact) by trade press describing IOCL as a 20% partner (alongside ONGC 55%, Prabha Energy 25%) in the connected North Karanpura CBM block and as a joint counterparty on a 2024 CBM gas-supply order with Prabha Energy -- consistent with IOCL, the largest consortium member, being the entity PNGRB ultimately authorised to build/operate the tie-in pipeline. StartLocation/EndLocation (Hazaribagh/Ranchi, both Jharkhand) match the notice's GGS-2/SV-3 endpoints at city-level granularity.

Lead only, not staged as a confident sourced value. The sheet's StartYear1=2026 matches PNGRB's 'target completion' field (Feb-26), which is the only dated figure PNGRB's register carries for this line -- but per the country guidance a target-completion date is a plan, not an outcome, and this specific target has already effectively been missed: the 31-May-2026 register (three months past the Feb-26 target) still shows 0 km operating and only 11 of 71 km welded (~15%). I did not find any independent (non-PNGRB) source giving a start/commissioning date, and I would rather leave this un-re-sourced than paper over a target that the regulator's own newest data shows is slipping. Flagging for a human: StartYear1=2026 is at real risk of needing to move to 2027+ once a later register edition or trade press confirms slippage -- worth re-checking against the next MIS edition rather than trusting Feb-26 as-is.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Status=construction is still correct. PNGRB's 31-May-2026 register (the newest edition) lists Hazaribagh-Ranchi under the UNDER CONSTRUCTION section, 0 km operating, 71 km under construction. Critically, this is not a static/dormant authorisation: welded length rose from 0 km (30-Jun-2025 edition) to 11 km, and lowered length from 0 to 6 km, between the two editions I checked -- genuine incremental pipe-laying activity, the opposite of the country note's 'live authorisation with 0 km built for years' dormancy trap (Ennore-Nellore). Progress is real but slow (~15% of authorised length welded) and the register's own Feb-26 target-completion date has already passed as of this May-2026 edition, so a slip past 2026 is plausible -- flagged as an open StartYear1 lead above rather than a status change, since 'construction, running behind an internal target' is not one of the dormancy triggers (those apply to proposed/shelved rows going quiet, not to a line with rising build metrics). No independent non-PNGRB dated evidence found (IOCL's own projects-under-implementation page did not resolve/redirect during this pass; cspm.gov.in did not resolve).

summary: P5412 Hazaribagh-Ranchi: real, well-documented PNGRB-authorised IOCL common-carrier lateral (CBM tie-in to Urja Ganga), correctly classified, no duplicate -- construction status confirmed with rising build progress through May-2026; one spec concern staged (LengthKnown 65.00->71.00 km, Capacity 1.03->1.00 MMSCMD, both PNGRB-current vs the sheet's stale prior-edition figures) plus Owner ref added; StartYear1=2026 left UNRESOLVED as a target-completion date already at risk of slipping.
